text: Remember 2002,
every dentist, law firm, and hardware
store needed computers, email, and a network.
Almost none could set it up themselves.
So every town had a computer guy.
Every tech wave creates a local services layer.
AI is that moment again.
Small businesses need AI to answer calls,
book appointments, and follow up.
Right now, fewer
than one in five, use it.
But this time, you don't have
to be the guy with the tool bag.
Mercury builds your complete AI agency,
and their team runs it.
You own 100% of the
business from day one.
reviewing the pipeline
five to ten hours a week,
be the owner of the
computer guy business of this decade,
book a strategy call.
